question: Estimate the reach of a multi-channel campaign for a product launch combining TV, digital, OOH, and PR.
idealClarificationQuestions: Total reach across all channels (deduped) for a major product launch (e.g., new smartphone, new car)? Yes.
Budget: ~₹50 cr media spend over 6 weeks? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Sum reach by channel; deduplicate via overlap multiplier.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: TV reach (₹25 cr media → ~3,500 GRPs): 1+ reach ~80 crore Indians (TV watchers).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: PR + earned media (₹2 cr): ~5-10 crore reached via news, articles.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: These questions probe your ability to think in funnels: how prospects move from impression → action → customer. The key is knowing realistic step-by-step conversion rates by channel and category. Compound the drops and end with a sanity check against industry benchmarks.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Digital reach (₹15 cr → Meta + YouTube + display)
OOH reach (₹6 cr → 50 prime hoardings + airport + metro)
benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~15 crore unique person-impressions; ~5 crore unique people.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Print (₹2 cr → top 3 metros, 3 days full page)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: de-duped via simple correlation analysis: total unique = ~85-90 crore individuals reached.

calculationFlow: TV reach (₹25 cr media → ~3,500 GRPs): 1+ reach ~80 crore Indians (TV watchers).
Digital reach (₹15 cr → Meta + YouTube + display): ~30 crore unique.
OOH reach (₹6 cr → 50 prime hoardings + airport + metro): ~15 crore unique person-impressions; ~5 crore unique people.
PR + earned media (₹2 cr): ~5-10 crore reached via news, articles.
Print (₹2 cr → top 3 metros, 3 days full page): ~5 crore unique readers.
Sum (with overlap): de-duped via simple correlation analysis: total unique = ~85-90 crore individuals reached.
